units.namespaceAndKeyBytes: Complete admitted lookup namespace/key carrier bytes and privately observed match bytes, including repeated comparisons; does not enlarge the selected key codec ceiling.
units.privateContextArtifactBytes: Each complete original match/context artifact; original custody and containing archive limits also apply.
units.nativeEncodedRowBytes: Per actual selected native encoded row, including full private framing/context/hex/source columns; contributes independently to cumulative result and peak-owned limits.
units.nativeSubmissions: All actual original data, context, authority and containment submissions; a retry is not free.
units.ownedPeakBytes: All request, key/context, adapter/decoder, catalog/owner and serialization buffers/copies still owned by the original call.
units.nativeEncodedResultBytes: Cumulative complete native encoded result bytes received across every original lookup/header/node/scalar/context/authority/containment submission, including repeated observations; no per-batch reset.
units.publicRecordCanonicalBytes: Complete final public record canonical bytes, including all defined/retained members; partial batch outputs cannot each claim a fresh ceiling.
units.cumulativeChargedBytes: Cumulative admitted input/copy/decode/comparison/serialization byte work across the entire original operation; release of occupancy does not refund spent work.
units.qualifiedOwnerEntries: Complete original qualified owner/property/retained inventory entries under the selected admission meaning; not automatically the number of tree states or a per-batch limit.

qualification: Separate unadopted larger-submission candidate; other byte/work/time limits remain independent. The 10000-state example establishes submission arithmetic only. All actual lookup/context/authority/containment paths must fit the remaining capacity, and complete native/driver/allocator feasibility must be qualified before adoption.
